admin.title: Authoring
admin.intro: Every article, chapter and news item on the site, with the state of each language.

access.needsPasskeyTitle: Sign in with your passkey to open authoring
access.needsPasskeyBody: Authoring only opens on a session started with a passkey, so a password alone can never publish to the site. Sign out, then sign in again with “Use a passkey”.
access.noPasskey: No passkey yet? Add one under Settings, Security first.

source.database: Content is served from the database. Changes to the JSON files in the repository are copied in on the next start, except for items edited here.
source.notConfigured: The database is not set up (DATABASE_URL is missing), so the site is serving the JSON files and nothing can be edited here yet.
source.unavailable: The database could not be reached, so the site is serving the JSON files. Check the server log; nothing can be edited until it is back.

admin.comingNext: Everything in the plan is here: articles, chapters, modules and news, images, scheduling, history and export. Still optional: one-click Tamil AI drafts and reviewer roles.
admin.summary: {articles, plural, one {# article} other {# articles}} · {chapters, plural, one {# chapter} other {# chapters}} ({written} written) · {news} news items

learn.heading: Learning hub
learn.hint: Open a module to edit its title, put its chapters in order, or add and edit chapters.

editor.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it on a published article changes its link.
editor.tagsHint: Separate with commas. Used by search.
editor.author: Author
editor.coverHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB, ideally 1600 × 900. Shown on cards and the home page.
editor.title: Title
editor.aiDraft: Machine-translated, not yet reviewed (readers see a label)
editor.bodyHint: Every language has the same blocks in the same order. Adding, moving or removing a block changes all languages; text is typed per language. Write '{section_80c_limit}' and similar to show current figures from the rule pack.

fields.heading: Heading text
fields.question: Question {n}
fields.alt: Alt text: what the image shows, for people who can't see it
fields.caption: Caption

editor.saved: Saved. Published languages are live now.
editor.lastSaved: Last saved {when} by {who} · {count, plural, one {# saved version} other {# saved versions}}
editor.neverSaved: Not edited here yet: this still matches its JSON file. Saving moves it to authoring for good.
editor.previewBanner: Preview of the last save in {language} ({state}). Readers only see published languages.

errors.slugTaken: Another article already uses this web address.
errors.notConfigured: The database is not available, so nothing can be saved right now.
errors.forbidden: Your session has ended or lacks a passkey. Sign in again with your passkey.
errors.failed: Saving failed. Your changes are still here; try again.

upload.notAnImage: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images can be uploaded.
upload.forbidden: Your session has ended or lacks a passkey. Sign in again with your passkey.
upload.notConfigured: The database is not available, so images can't be uploaded right now.

errors.notFound: This item no longer exists. Go back to the content list and open it again.
errors.invalidFields: Something is missing or not allowed: check the web address (lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens) and the other settings.

problems.quizAnswer: {language}: block {block} has a quiz answer that is not one of its options.
problems.unknownCalculator: {language}: block {block} points to a calculator that does not exist.
problems.structureDiffers: {language}: block {block} does not match the source.

editor.publishAtHint: Leave empty to publish on save. With a time, readers see this language from then on; until then it stays hidden.
editor.outOfDate: The source language changed after this translation was last edited. Check it against the source.
editor.restoredNotice: You are looking at the version saved {when}. Nothing has changed on the site yet: Save to make it the current version, or leave the page to keep the current one.

chapter.slugHintNew: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Part of the chapter's link, so it can't be changed after the first save.
chapter.slugHintFixed: Part of the chapter's link; fixed once the chapter exists.
chapter.removeConfirm: Remove this chapter? It is not published in any language, so no reader link breaks. Its saved versions are kept.

module.title: Title
module.orderHint: Use the arrows to change the order, then Save. Readers see chapters in this order.
module.textMissing: Every language with a title also needs a summary, and English needs both.

newsEditor.sourceHint: The page you checked the news against. Readers see it as the source.
newsEditor.languagesHint: News is live in every language that has a title as soon as you save. Leave a language empty to show the English one there.
newsEditor.incomplete: Add a title and summary in English (and in any other language you start), a source name and a source link starting with https://.
newsEditor.removeConfirm: Remove this news item from the site? Its saved versions are kept.

admin.exportHint: Downloads every article, module, chapter and news item, drafts included, as one JSON file in the same shape as the files in the repository. Uploaded images stay on the site and are referenced by link.

history.heading: {count, plural, one {# saved version} other {# saved versions}}
history.title: Version saved {when}
history.intro: Saved by {who}. The table shows what is different now compared with this version.
history.gone: This item has been removed from the site, so there is nothing to compare with.
history.restoreHint: Opens the editor with this version loaded. Nothing changes on the site until you save there.
history.same: This version is the same as the current one.

usage.title: Usage
usage.intro: What members and visitors did: counts only, no names and no amounts. Member actions come from the audit log; calculator runs and quick checks are anonymous events.
usage.noDatabase: No database is configured, so there is nothing to count.
usage.northStar: North-star metric: members who completed at least one meaningful planning action in the month, such as a check-up, a plan step, a goal or a data update.

activation.title: Activation (last 90 days)
activation.intro: Of the people who signed up, how many reached the first result.

usage.privacy: No personal data is read for this page.
